caption: The drawing depicts a single standing statue of a female figure on a rectangular plinth decorated with a chevron pattern. The statue appears to be made of stone or marble, rendered in muted beige, ivory, and brown tones with shading to suggest depth and texture. The figure has wavy hair parted in the middle and falling around the face, and the detailed facial features are front-facing. The attire consists of a long, draped gown with numerous folds, covering both legs and one arm, while the other arm is partially visible with the hand resting on the chest. The background is plain, with no other objects or decorations. The overall color palette is subdued, dominated by earthy, stone-like hues.
title: Circus Wagon Figure
